restaurantName: Origin at The Royal Garden Hotel
bio: Origin at The Royal Garden Hotel, winner of two AA rosettes, offers a vibrant and inviting space to relax and savour the finest authentic British seasonal produce. The passionate team meticulously prepares dishes using locally sourced, seasonal ingredients from renowned and exclusively British producers. This commitment guarantees that every dish is a reflection of the high-quality ingredients that inspire Origin Kensington.  Continuing to celebrate British seasonal produce, Origin Kensington is delighted to unveil a new classically British afternoon tea experience on the ground floor of the Royal Garden Hotel. Nestled in a bright and inviting space offering breathtaking views of Kensington Gardens, it sets the perfect scene for a leisurely afternoon tea, followed by a stroll in Hyde Park or shopping on High Street Kensington.  Origin Kensington afternoon tea showcases the finest British seasonal produce, seamlessly blending classic service with a contemporary twist. Begin your experience with a selection of your favourite teas, expertly prepared before your eyes. Then indulge in a variety of savoury bites, followed by an exquisite array of scones, seasonal jams, and clotted cream. To complete your experience, savour the delightful assortment of sweets.
pageTitle: Origin at The Royal Garden Hotel
